Sunk cost $900,000.00 is gone either way, so it is excluded from expected value from today.

Option stop:
EV(stop from today) = sale value = $60,000.00
EV(stop) = 60000 = 60000

Option continue:
Cost to finish from today = $200,000.00
P(success) = 0.70, payoff if success = $1,200,000.00
P(failure) = 1 - 0.70 = 0.30, payoff if failure = $50,000.00

Formula:
EV(continue from today) = -cost_to_finish + P(success)*payoff_success + P(failure)*payoff_failure
EV(continue) = -200000.00 + 0.70*1200000.00 + 0.30*50000.00

Independent recomputation:
0.70*1200000.00 = 840000.00
0.30*50000.00 = 15000.00
Expected gross payoff = 840000.00 + 15000.00 = 855000.00
EV(continue) = -200000.00 + 855000.00 = 655000.00

Comparison from today:
EV(continue) = 655000.00 > EV(stop) = 60000.00
Better decision is continue with $655,000.00.

{"choice": "continue", "value": 655000}
